text: The paper reports that the ORM performs slightly better than the majority voting baseline while the PRM strongly outperforms both, reaching higher performance for all values of N with a gap that widens as N increases, which indicates the PRM is more effective than both at searching over a large number of model-generated solutions.
title: PRM beats ORM and majority voting in best-of-N search
